services.value: Pace provides analytical and environmental testing services across a range of listed testing categories (e.g., PFAS, Legionella, metals/trace metals, USP 797/800, VOCs) and also offers CDMO/CRO services including “Drug Product Development and Manufacturing,” “Analytical Testing,” and “Regulatory and Operational Support.” In addition, the facility/professional services sections describe facility qualification, cleanroom testing & certification, validation and compliance, laboratory relocation, and environmental monitoring (e.g., cleanroom environmental monitoring, water testing, and compressed air/gas system testing).
